content:
We are currently closely monitoring several iPhone 18 Pro accessories and plan to place orders before the Friday cutoff, as we will be using them ourselves this year. If we had to pick, Apple's AirTag 2 and the brand-new AirPods Pro 3 (or AirPods 5) are absolutely the best matches for the iPhone 18 Pro—not to mention the world's top-tier Polishing Cloth, which is equally worth buying. But this time we want to go deeper—covering chargers, MagSafe car mounts, cases, wallets, and everything in between. We'll go through them one by one below.

iPhone 18 Pro Accessories

  • Chance—Apple 40W Dynamic Power Adapter (up to 60W)
  • Ben—Apple TechWoven Case
  • Michael—Anker Prime 25W Qi2.2 3-in-1 Foldable MagSafe Charger
  • Arin—Apple iPhone FineWoven MagSafe Wallet
  • Ryan—MagSafe Car Mount (designed for iPhone 18 Pro)
  • Fernando—Burgundy Picogo Air Ultra-Slim Magnetic Power Bank
  • Simon—Baseus Enercore 70W Retractable USB-C Travel Charger
  • Justin—Satechi 25W 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand
  • Reinette—Spigen Ultra Hybrid MagFit Case
  • Other Genuinely Recommended Accessories

If you want to charge your newly purchased iPhone 18 Pro or iPhone 18 Pro Max at the fastest possible speed, you need a compatible charging adapter. Specifically, you need a charger that supports Adjustable Voltage Supply—and Apple's own product is the best option on the market. It's compact enough and folds up neatly, capable of charging your iPhone 18 Pro or iPhone 18 Pro Max to 50% within 15 minutes.

Apple's TechWoven case comes in a variety of deep, rich color options. It looks great, feels fantastic, the anodized aluminum buttons have a solid tactile feel, and the entire case is made from 100% recycled polyester yarn—good for the environment too.

This lightweight 3-in-1 wireless charger from Anker can power three devices simultaneously through a single portable accessory, with the iPhone charging pad supporting Qi2 wireless charging and MagSafe compatibility. When folded, it's compact enough to slip easily into a travel bag—which means you'll never have to drag a tangle of cables and adapters to a hotel again—or you can place it on your nightstand or desk to neatly manage your entire Apple ecosystem. It's currently on sale at Amazon for nearly 35% off, an all-time low price.

Apple's FineWoven MagSafe wallet has always been a must-have accessory for Apple fans who prefer a minimalist style. It can easily hold 3 to 4 cards—whether it's an ID, a few credit cards, or a hotel room key card—perfect for those who don't want to carry a bulky wallet around every day.

Every time I drive, I really want to find a stable and safe place to put my phone. ESR's MagSafe car mount is my top choice. You can securely magnetically attach your iPhone 18 Pro or older models to the mount, and the mount clips directly onto the air vent for added convenience. This MagSafe car mount not only protects your iPhone well, but also keeps the screen clearly visible, and charging during driving poses no problem at all.

I've always believed that a truly practical magnetic power bank that you can carry with your iPhone every day must be thin enough. Baseus has just released what I consider to be an almost perfect magnetic power bank. The Picogo Air is only 0.27 inches thick and weighs just 3.7 ounces. It has a built-in 5,000mAh battery, supporting 7.5W wireless charging and 22.5W wired input. The best part is its brand-new burgundy color, which pairs perfectly with the new iPhone—this is what an ultra-slim magnetic power bank should look like.

If you travel frequently, you'll understand that packing your tech bag neatly is already half the battle. So I'm always on the lookout for versatile charging solutions. Baseus's travel charger is absolutely perfect—it supports plugs for over 200 countries worldwide and is designed to charge six devices simultaneously. But for me, the biggest highlight is the built-in 70W retractable USB-C cable, which can fast-charge your iPhone 18 Pro at full speed while steadily powering your iPad, MacBook, and other devices.

Michael previously picked what I considered the best foldable MagSafe charger for travel, but this time I want to focus on my two favorite desktop 3-in-1 models: the Satechi 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand, which is absolutely stunning and minimalist in its gorgeous space gray black; and the Anker Smart Display 3-in-1, which I also love—but the Satechi is just so elegant and refined, there's simply no comparison.

After spending a fortune on the iPhone 18 Pro or Pro Max, I usually opt for more affordable accessories rather than splurging on the most expensive items again. Spigen has many budget-friendly MagSafe cases. My personal top pick is this clear Ultra Hybrid MagFit case, which is significantly cheaper than other brands—plus there are opaque multi-color options, all supporting MagSafe fast wireless charging. These cases inject DuraClear blue resin into the TPU frame to prevent yellowing, combined with shock-absorbing design; it's worth noting that the Camera Control button surface is also wrapped in a thin layer of TPU.

  • AirTag 2
  • Anker 100W USB-C Smart Display Charger
  • Beats Woven USB-C Cable
  • Brand-New Pitaka Burgundy Aramid Fiber iPhone 18 Pro Case
  • Nomad iPhone 18 Pro Leather Case
  • Aulumu A18 Pro Drop-Resistant Case
  • Twelve South Butterfly 2-in-1
  • Nomad Find My Tracker Card
